pantalla.texto: The rest of Rimor keeps working and nothing was lost.

inicio.vacioTitulo: What you capture will show up here
inicio.vacio: Whatever you paste will appear here with what Rimor understood.
inicio.nadaSinClasificarTexto: What you paste will show here with what Rimor understood.
inicio.primerUsoTitulo: Paste the first thing you have at hand
inicio.primerUsoTexto: Rimor understands what you paste and answers with what it saw. Try one of these:
inicio.noAnadido: It could not be added to the collection.
inicio.noCambiado: The type could not be changed.
inicio.sinOtroTipo: This item cannot be read with another reader.
inicio.version: I saved it as its version {n}.

elemento.noEncontrado: It may have been emptied from the bin, or the address is not that of any item.
elemento.enPapelera: It is in the bin: it will be deleted for good when the bin is emptied.
elemento.noMovido: It could not be moved to the bin.
elemento.noDisponible: The file is not in the workspace.
elemento.guiaNota: Ctrl+Enter or leaving the field saves · Esc leaves the note as it was

versiones.restaurarTexto: Its text, title and notes become the item’s again; what is there now stays in the history and can be recovered.
versiones.sinCambios: It is the same as the current one.

papelera.vacia: What you move to the bin stays here until you empty it.

vaciarTexto.one: {n} item will be deleted for good. First download the ZIP with it; then you can empty the bin.
vaciarTexto.other: {n} items will be deleted for good. First download the ZIP with all of them; then you can empty the bin.

papelera.noVaciada: The ZIP could not be made: nothing was deleted.
papelera.descargada: Check that the ZIP is in your downloads before emptying.
papelera.noDescargada: The ZIP could not be downloaded: nothing was deleted.
papelera.noBorrada: The bin could not be fully emptied: what was not deleted is still in it.

vaciarTextoSinZip.one: {n} item will be deleted for good. You can download its ZIP first.
vaciarTextoSinZip.other: {n} items will be deleted for good. You can download their ZIP first.

cambiada.one: The comparison has changed: {refs} changed since it was made. It has been recalculated.
cambiada.other: The comparison has changed: {refs} changed since it was made. It has been recalculated.

faltan.one: {refs} is missing: showing the last saved result.
faltan.other: {refs} are missing: showing the last saved result.

comparacion.yaNoSePuede: It can no longer be calculated: {motivo} Showing the last saved result.

motivos.distintoTipo: Only two of the same type can be compared: {a} and {b} are not.
motivos.sinComparacion: For now only logs with logs and measurements with measurements are compared.
motivos.sinValores: One of the measurements has no values.
motivos.otroLector: One of them was not read by the reader of its type (it was saved as a file), so it lacks what is needed to compare it.
motivos.demasiadas: For now two sources are compared, no more.

mediciones.mismaMaquina: If they were measured on the same machine, repeat on another one to generalise.
mediciones.antesDeMedir: Decide the number of repetitions before measuring; repeating until a difference shows up increases false positives.

nuevos.one: {n} new message in the bad one
nuevos.other: {n} new messages in the bad one

ausentes.one: {n} from the good one is missing
ausentes.other: {n} from the good one are missing

logs.igualesTexto: The same messages in the same order, ignoring dates, IDs and numbers.
logs.tabla: Both at the point where they part

crear.ninguno: There is no other of the same type to compare with.
crear.seleccionaDos: To compare, select two with x.
crear.noCreada: The comparison could not be created.

hilo.vacio: Here you will see the thread’s items in order, with what you learned.
hilo.nota: How it was solved, in one line
hilo.notaEjemplo: Raised the read timeout to 60 s
hilo.noAnadido: It could not be added to the thread.
hilo.sinOtros: There are no other open threads.
hilo.confirmarTexto: An item is only in one thread: it leaves the one it is in now.
hilo.sacado: {ref} is no longer in any thread

buscar.vacio: Type words or filters such as tipo:log or #tag.
buscar.sinResultadosTexto: Remove a filter or try another word.

coleccion.vaciaTitulo: There is nothing in this collection yet
coleccion.vacio: Add items with @name in the composer, with c on Home or from their “Details”.

borrarTexto.one: Its item stays, without this collection.
borrarTexto.other: Its {n} items stay, without this collection.

datos.json: Single JSON. Attachments over 1 MB are left out and the file says so.
datos.arbol:
manifest.json        ← counts and hashes
elementos/2026/10/…
comparaciones/  hilos/  investigaciones/  documentos/
adjuntos/            ← by hash
historial/           ← versions
colecciones.json  papelera/  .rimor/

noEncontrada.texto: This link does not lead to any Rimor screen.

fallo.manifest: Its manifest.json cannot be read: it may come from another Rimor version. Nothing was changed.
fallo.otro: The browser did not let us open the data. Close the other Rimor tabs and try again.
fallo.esquemaNuevo: It was created by a newer version of Rimor. Reload the page to use it; nothing was changed.

persistencia.texto: The browser may delete what a website stores if it runs out of space. If you protect it, it will not do so without asking.
persistencia.denegada: The browser did not grant it: make backups from time to time.
persistencia.noDisponible: This browser does not allow protecting it: make backups from time to time.

aviso.memoria: This browser does not allow saving: what you capture will be lost when you close the tab.
aviso.privada: This looks like a private window: everything will be deleted when you close it.
aviso.soloLectura: Rimor is open in another tab: here you can only read.

error.texto: The reader failed on this item. Here is the original as it is.

lectores.cifras: Figures you can cite in a document with

captura.demasiadoGrande: “{nombre}” is {tam}: the limit is {limite} per file.
captura.sinLector: There is no reader for “{nombre}” yet.
captura.noDeshecho: Something was not undone: it had already been edited or moved.

compositor.placeholderHilo: Reply in this thread: a note, a log, how you solved it…
compositor.iraASuHilo: : it will go to its thread
compositor.buscar: Search “{texto}”. Enter to see it here.
compositor.sugerencia: Suggestion: {opcion}. Arrows to change, Enter to choose.

secretos.one: I hid a secret before saving.

respuestas.sinDatos: Saved as {tipo}. I could not analyse it: the original is shown.
respuestas.coleccion: Shall I add it to the {nombre} collection?

paleta.placeholder: An action, a collection or something saved

exportar.fallo: Could not export. Nothing was changed.
exportar.hechoSinApuntar: Exported {nombre} ({tam}). Not recorded as a backup: another tab has the space open.
exportar.atascada: The export stalled and was stopped. Nothing was changed.

importar.sinArchivo: Choose a Rimor ZIP or JSON in Data and backups.
importar.validoZip: Valid ZIP: schema {esquema}, {n} files, no path outside the space.
importar.validoJson: Valid JSON: schema {esquema}, {n} files, no path outside the space.
importar.conflictoAqui: Here {aqui} · in the file {paquete} → the one here stays; the other goes to history
importar.conflictoPaquete: Here {aqui} · in the file {paquete} → the file’s stays; the one here goes to history

verReasignadas.one: A ref is already used here

importar.reasignada: becomes {a} (the old one stays as an alias)

verAvisos.one: One file stays as it is

importar.soloLectura: Another tab has the space open: import from there.

fusionar.texto: If both changed, the newest wins and the other stays in history.

reemplazar.texto: Deletes “{nombre}” and loads the file. A copy is exported first.
reemplazar.textoSinCopia: Deletes “{nombre}” and loads the file. No copy is exported first (you turned it off in Data and backups).

importar.sinCopia: The backup could not be exported: nothing was touched.
importar.noImportado: Something failed while writing. What was written stays; import again to complete it.
importar.hecho: Imported: {nuevos} new, {actualizados} updated, {conflictos} conflicts resolved · reindexing

avisos.sinHashes: Its manifest has no hashes: the files could not be checked against the export.
avisos.conExcluidos: It is a JSON with excluded attachments: those are not included.
avisos.entidadSeQueda: is already here and differs: the one here stays.
avisos.archivoSeQueda: is already here and differs: the one here stays.

zip.zip64: uses ZIP64, which Rimor does not read
zip.rutaInsegura: is a path that leaves the space or is not valid
zip.solapadas: shares its data with another entry
zip.tamanoMayor: holds more data than it declares
zip.tamanoDistinto: does not hold the size it declares
zip.metodo: uses a compression Rimor does not read

importar.esquemaNuevo: is from a newer version of Rimor
importar.hash: is not the exported one (its hash does not match)
importar.elemento: does not follow the item format
importar.entidad: does not follow the comparison or thread format
importar.migracion: could not be brought to the current version
importar.idRepetido: repeats the id of another item in the file
importar.refRepetida: repeats the ref of another item in the file
importar.rutaChoca: clashes with a folder or a file (it is where a folder is needed, or the other way round)
importar.rutaOcupada: would go where another item already is

importar.noRecargado: It was imported, but the space could not be reread: reload the page.

recordatorio.one: Your last backup is from {cuando} and you have made {n} change since. A ZIP takes a moment.
recordatorio.other: Your last backup is from {cuando} and you have made {n} changes since. A ZIP takes a moment.

copias.recordatorioNunca: You have not made any backup of this space yet. A ZIP takes a moment and is all you have.
copias.zipPrevio: Export a ZIP before replacing or emptying the bin

ajustes.meta: Saved in the space (.rimor/ajustes.json) and applied at once.
ajustes.soloLectura: Another tab has the space open: change them from there.
ajustes.duda: Hesitate between two types when they are less than {n} points apart
ajustes.dudaTexto: If two readers are close, the reply offers the other type. More margin, more often.
ajustes.secretosTexto: What is hidden before saving. Everything, by default.
ajustes.secretosAviso: Anything matching a disabled rule will be saved as is.

tiposSecreto.contrasena: Passwords in URLs and connection strings

ajustes.respuestasTexto: Which types Rimor replies to when capturing.
ajustes.redTexto: Rimor does not connect anywhere. When link enrichment arrives, you will choose here what may be queried.
ajustes.noGuardado: The setting could not be saved: it applies now, but not after reopening.
